name: latex-deepseek
description: LaTeX in AI Sidebar for DeepSeek Harness, with an independently packaged local editor.

interface.displayName: LaTeX in AI Sidebar for DeepSeek Harness
interface.shortDescription: Write, revise and review papers in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
interface.longDescription: Bring paper writing, AI edits and PDF review into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. Includes automatic TeX compilation, bundled PDF.js, Markdown previews and per-change Keep / Undo. Send, project chat and history summaries use the installed signed-in DeepSeek Harness CLI. Optional main-chat forwarding uses a separately configured bridge. Requires Python 3.10+ and an existing TeX installation for PDF compilation. Installed independently from the native latex-codex plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use latex-deepseek to open my LaTeX or Markdown file with DeepSeek Harness.
